content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-what-actually-how-2|Payment Methods]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail-4|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-11|cloudflare]] Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy is a popular choice for many digital creators because of its user-friendly interface and integrated payment solutions. However, it only supports specific regions, leaving creators in restricted countries without access. In contrast, platforms like Gumroad and PayPal also face similar limitations. While they offer various tools for selling digital products, their geographical restrictions prevent many creators from utilizing these services. COREMERCH's sovereign stacks, on the other hand, empower creators by ensuring they have full ownership and control over their commerce infrastructure, regardless of their location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 worldwide, effectively locking out a significant number of creators. PayPal is slightly more accessible but can impose account suspensions that may hold funds for up to 180 days without appeal. This creates financial uncertainty for creators who rely on these platforms. In contrast, COREMERCH eliminates these barriers altogether by providing a digital commerce solution that is built for creators in restricted countries. With infrastructure sovereignty, users can operate their stores without the risk of sudden account restrictions or fund holds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing speed and fees, traditional platforms like PayPal and Gumroad may charge transaction fees ranging from 2.9% to 5% plus additional costs for currency conversion. This can dramatically cut into a creator's profits, especially in restricted regions where margins are already tight. COREMERCH, however, offers a low-cost solution through NOWPayments, which charges only a 0.5% transaction fee with no hidden costs. This allows creators to receive payments quickly and efficiently, ensuring they retain more of their earnings while also enjoying greater control over their financial transactions.
Complete control over your store means no more worrying about account restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical concern for digital creators. Platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad retain significant control over the data and assets associated with your store, which can lead to a lack of security and stability. In stark contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure is designed to grant creators complete ownership of their digital products and customer data after deployment. The system automates payment processing, product delivery, and order management, ensuring a seamless experience without the need for ongoing subscriptions or platform dependency.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right commerce architecture depends on your specific needs as a creator. If you're looking for a quick and straightforward solution, COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack is an excellent option for getting started. For those needing more robust functionalities, the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations for email deliverability and support for multiple products. In either case, COREMERCH provides a dependable and scalable infrastructure that allows creators to thrive without the limitations imposed by traditional platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Automated payment processing allows you to focus on creating, not managing transactions.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
